title: Application Logging Journald Entity
description: Systemd-journald-specific configuration. Extends Application/Logging with journald-specific settings.

system_max_use.description: Max disk usage for journal files (e.g., "500M", "2G").

system_max_file_size.description: Max size of individual journal files (e.g., "50M").

max_retention_sec.description: Max retention time for journal entries (e.g., "1month", "2week").

rate_limit_burst.description: Maximum number of messages per rate limit interval.
